programs.description: Baba Kalyani, a police officer, travels to Kochi to uncover a terrorist conspiracy. He must not only work on the case but also deal with old rivals who are hell-bent on settling scores with him.
Sadasivan comes across a house where the owner, Kumaran, has committed suicide to protect his wife, Soumini. However, what is even stranger is that a man who is visually challenged is always around.
Hareendran, a software tycoon, runs a successful company with his childhood friend. However, things take an unexpected turn when his friend damages his reputation.
Divakaran is a selfish and miserly man. When he fails to buy a truck for himself, he goes after a mythical treasure hidden in a river.
In 1796, Kerala Varma, king of Pazhassi, leaves his kingdom due to the East India Company and seeks refuge in the Wayanad forests. He then uses guerrilla warfare tactics against his enemies.
After moving into a hostel in Bangalore for their engineering course, three teenagers get into a terrible brawl with their seniors. To exact revenge, they decide to befriend a gangster.
Arun, a young man, enrols in an engineering college but falls prey to bad habits. As he grows up, he decides to turn over a new leaf and become a responsible adult.
A group of masked fugitives kill the girlfriend of an international businessman, Casanovva. In order to avenge her death and capture the culprits, Casanovva sets up a fake television reality show.
Prince remains a bachelor, despite his good qualities, However, chaos follows when he marries a woman who is his polar opposite.
Aby, who was abandoned at his wedding, meets a withdrawn woman in need of help. Together, they embark on a healing journey, until his former lover returns and offers a new perspective on his dreams.

Sajna rejects the love of her college mate, Ameer, as she is already engaged to her cousin Anwar. However, Sajna's marriage with Anwar gets cancelled due to an unexpected turn of events.
Dr. Ruben Isaac takes up a position in a psychiatric hospital and uses humanitarian methods to treat his patients. However, things take a turn when his real identity is uncovered.
An anthology of three stories. The first story involves a murder investigation, the second story is about a group of goons following a girl, the third involves five friends delivering a package.
Rini, the right-hand of a corrupt businessman, begins to become greedy for money. He asks his boss to help him settle down with a jewellery shop, but fate has other plans for him.
Srividya, a young woman, is put in a coma by corrupt doctors. However, her spirit enters a teddy bear and seeks out a lonely man named Shiva to uncover medical crimes.
ACP Antony Moses has managed to track down his friend's killer when he meets with an accident resulting in partial memory loss. Soon, he is reassigned to investigate the murder and find the culprit.
Love knocks on the door of Rambo, an unlucky man. However, a dilemma arises when he develops feelings for two women at the same time.
The survivor of a heart transplant attends the wedding of his donor's daughter. However, when circumstances delay his return from the venue, he gradually becomes affectionate towards her.
A historic rifle club in the Western Ghats becomes the centre of a fight for survival when a dangerous arms dealer and his gang come seeking revenge.

Aaron, an ardent cricket fan, decides to be positive even after losing his sight. When he gets the chance to realise his dream of entering the cricket team for the blind, he takes it.
Antony, a lorry driver, struggles with an inferiority complex stemming from his skin colour, leading him to create ongoing problems for his family.
Sreehari has returned home from Paris after six years. He tries to settle some scores and clear misunderstandings with his old friends before leaving his village.

Dinesh, a conceited and wealthy young bachelor, goes to extreme lengths to impress a girl named Shobha with the help of his best friend Sagar, and Dinesh eventually hopes to marry Shobha.

Unni and Ashwathy's life takes a turn after he accidentally kills her cousin in a tussle. After spending time in prison, he moves to Chennai with his family, hoping to start a fresh chapter, but his past catches up with him.
A struggling director gets cheated by his friend who steals his script and becomes a famous actor. However, when he finally gets the chance to direct a film, he is forced to cast a dubious actor.

Jaison, a teenager, has a crush on Keerthy, but she does not reciprocate his feelings. To make things worse, he gets in trouble with Ravi, the new teacher who is liked by everyone, especially Keerthy.
A man falls for his boss' daughter and convinces his friend to pose as his father to gain approval for their marriage, resulting in a hilarious series of misunderstandings.

Jimmy, a petty thief, is tasked with smuggling the print of an unreleased film out of the city. His journey, however, is peppered with several confusing situations.
A WWI veteran becomes a postman and delivers letters and money orders to the families of soldiers. However, his visits soon turn into a bad omen when WWII breaks out.
Shivaramakrishnan is a government employee who struggles to make ends meet. In order to earn some quick money, he and his friends start a daycare centre, which proves to be even more disastrous.
A man murders his rich brother-in-law with the help of three co-conspirators to amass his wealth. He also manages to discredit the deceased man's illegitimate son.

Irshad and Haseeb, two teenage boys from Mattanchery, share a passion for pigeon flying, a local game. Later, Irshad opens up about a tragic incident that ruined many friendships in the neighbourhood.

Unni, a stockbroker, lives with his family happily, until he is greeted by a surprise visitor, who is his childhood friend. Soon, things take a turn as he discovers the true intentions of his old schoolmate, leading to chaos.
Following the loss of his sister, a young man is forced to reflect on his childhood and reassess his future. However, he finds support and courage from unexpected quarters.
A man sets out to investigate the death of his brother at a haunted house, leading him to come across several supernatural experiences.
Jayaraman, a liftman and caretaker, relies on his non-visual senses and martial arts expertise to protect a little girl from a vengeful ex-con who is out to settle an old score.

Friends Chacko and Hari are fed up with their employer and plan a trip to Goa. Their trip turns into something unusual when they discover a mysterious bag.
James, a highly efficient police officer, sets out to unveil the mystery behind a burglary that shook everyone in the city. He meets several people to solve the crime and put the thieves behind bars.
Agricultural officer Sachithanandan and his wife Shyama's life changes after the husband's womanising friend Jose visits for a few days.
The lives of two martial arts instructors are upended when they become the targets of a gang, who decide to assassinate the brother and sister duo.
Venu, the owner of a small-scale finance firm, loses his son in an unfortunate incident. He gets involved in a lot of social work that soon leads him to become an obstacle in the way of his rivals.
Saji, Bonny, Bobby and Franky are siblings who mostly do not get along. However, a series of events forces them to keep their animosity aside and support each other.
In the village of Kudungassery where there is a dearth of public transport and crematorium, two political parties including the ruling party and the opposition engage in a fight for development.
A small village seeks help from a man with extraordinary force to protect them against man-eating tigers and the drug mafia.
A quiet woman's life is turned upside down when a rebel writer leaves his secret book with her. However, his words spark big changes she never expected.

A fugitive encounters his doppelgänger and plots to steal his identity for a quick escape. However, fate intervenes as he chooses to embrace and fight for his look-alike's mission.
Lakshmanan, an advocate specialising in women's divorce cases, ties the knot with Annie. However, trouble ensues when her hidden agenda emerges.
Siddharth often has problems with his wife Anjali owing to his short temper. Things take an unexpected turn when they get involved with a gangster.
Shaji Pappan's team emerges victorious in a tug of war competition, earning a cash prize, a trophy, and a female goat. However, the situation takes a turn when the team decides to slaughter the goat.
Radha and Sasikumar fall in love with each other. However, her life takes a turn when he refuses to marry her because of his family problems.

An illicit relationship between a Kathakali dancer and a young woman from an upper caste family results in an illegitimate baby. The dancer's worries stockpile when he is barred from seeing his child.
Returning to his village after the war to meet his family, Aloshy discovers that his brothers are working as henchmen for a local businessman and plotting against his father.
As Pushpa, a labourer, rises in the world of red sandalwood smuggling, he ends up making many enemies. However, violence ensues when the police try to topple his illegal business.
After relocating to a remote village on an island, a man hopes to restore his and his family's life. However, his family starts to witness paranormal incidents in their house.
